svg.title: World map — the journey from Bangkok to Tokyo
svg.desc: Pixel-art world map. A small mage walks a dotted road through 13 numbered checkpoints, raising a flag at each, then sails to a castle on an island. Quest log: 2023: started B.Sc. IT (Data Science and Business Analytics) at KMITL; 2023–24: 1st runner-up at I4C and at Krungsri × KMITL; Jul 2024: Data Science Intern at KBTG K-LAB; 2024: Silver Medal, Super AI Engineer Season 4; Nov 2024: LLM & Prompt Engineer Intern at Bot and Life; Apr 2025: teaching assistant, AIAT Super AI Engineer Season 5; Jul 2025: AI Engineer at Bot and Life; 2025: three first-place hackathon wins (BDI Royal Cup, ExxonMobil Bootcathon, Krungsri × KMITL); 2025: 2nd runner-up at AI Thailand Hackathon and Huawei ICT Competition; 2026: teaching assistant at KMITL, DGA and AIAT Super AI Season 6; 2026: six papers accepted, five as first author; Jul 2026: AI Engineer Intern at Asia Energy Tech; Sep 2026: Musashino University, Tokyo.
